The '''SW-7a ion cannon''' was a model of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] manufactured by [[ArMek/Legends|ArMek]]. The [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was armed with three of the cannons as part of its weapons loadout.<ref name="EGVV" /> They could fire singly, or linked to fire all three cannons simultaneously.<ref name="SC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>
